searchText: Hey, can someone help me know how are sequencers elected to sequence transactions? Are they selected from a validator set using an algorithm or are they completely controlled by the rollup operator or a trusted third party? What is the algorithm for selecting the sequencer for each rollup block? Would really appreciate a response. Thanks! <@&595685821026271242> ^^ It depends entirely on the rollup in question, it can be done in any way
